questions.q: 3 pens and 2 rulers cost £3.60. 5 pens and 1 ruler cost £4.60. Work out the cost of one pen and of one ruler.
Solve y = x + 1 and x² + y² = 25.
Find the points where y = x² − 3x + 2 meets y = 2x − 4.
